verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface for operating Gusto, such as an in-product assistant or a conversational command surface. The closest items are the Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server (Beta) and an 'agent-friendly' CLI. Both are developer tooling for Embedded Payroll partners that let external AI clients call the API, so they are adjacent building blocks and evidence for other stories, not natural-language operation of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
